tieu_de: Uranus transit through the 11th house: new friends and new futures
mo: Why am I losing touch with old friends?
Can this transit help my career?
My goals keep changing. Is that normal?

You join a group chat about an obscure hobby and end up with three new friends. A community project you only meant to help with once becomes a regular commitment. A goal you held for a decade suddenly looks irrelevant. Uranus in the 11th house reorganises your social circle and your sense of the future at the same time.

Uranus has a natural connection with this house, so the transit tends to feel at home here. Change arrives through people, networks and ideals, and it can take your life in directions you had never considered.

doan: The 11th house covers friends, groups, communities, networks and the hopes you hold for your future. Uranus here brings openings to join clubs, organisations and causes that match your interests and values. You meet people who think differently, and some of them become important allies.

Your personal goals are also on the table. Plans you made years ago may lose their appeal, and new aims emerge, sometimes suddenly. By the end of the transit, many people are working toward a future that did not appear on their earlier maps.
Planet Uranus Rules Aquarius Innovation, freedom, surprise
New friendships that form quickly around shared interests.
Old friendships fading because you no longer share the same outlook.
Invitations to join groups, online communities, boards or activist projects.
Contact with people from very different backgrounds or professions.
A change in what you hope to achieve over the next ten years.
Connections through technology leading to real opportunities.

This transit is one of the best times to widen your network. People you meet now may introduce ideas, contacts or offers that change your path. Groups built around progressive causes, technology or unusual interests are especially fertile ground.

It also gives you a chance to update your goals. Many people drift toward targets set by family or earlier ambitions. Uranus in the 11th makes it easier to see which of those still matter and to replace the rest with aims that genuinely excite you.

The sense of belonging can grow too. If you have felt out of place in your usual circles, this transit often brings you into contact with people who share your quirks, and that recognition can be a relief.

Social change can leave gaps. As your interests shift, some friends may feel left behind, and you may feel guilty for moving on. Groups formed suddenly can also dissolve suddenly, and group politics can become intense when everyone wants their own kind of freedom.
Changing goals too often is another risk. If every new friend brings a new plan, it is hard to make progress on any of them.

Uranus takes about 7 years to pass through a sign, and an 11th house transit generally runs over a similar period. Your house size depends on the house system and the latitude of your birth, so the transit may be shorter or longer. Aspects from Uranus to your natal Venus, Sun or Moon during these years can bring the biggest social shifts.
Say yes to invitations that match your real interests, even if the group seems unusual.
Stay in touch with old friends you value, even as your circles change.
Write down your goals once a year and see how they evolve. Keep the ones that last.
Contribute to at least one community or cause you care about. Uranus favours collective effort.
Before committing to a group's plans, check that they fit your own direction.

Your interests and values are shifting, and some friendships are built on who you used to be. Some will adapt, some will fade. The ones worth keeping usually survive with a little effort on both sides.
Often, yes. The 11th house covers networks, and new contacts made now can bring job offers, partnerships or collaborations, especially in innovative fields.
Yes. Uranus in the 11th reshapes your sense of the future. Let the new goals settle before acting on every one, and notice which ideas keep coming back.
